description.value:
Adapted from the emergency defense sphere (NS p. 153). Once per day, when damage reduces the mech to ¼ of its Hit Points or fewer, a resilient sphere (as the spell) forms around the mech's space automatically, and the mech spends 3 PP. It doesn't form if the mech has fewer than 3 PP. It lasts until the start of the mech's next turn.

Auxiliary Slots: 2.
